svg.text: Core entities · foreign-key chains read left-to-right · Postgres (orders) primary store
Customer → Address (1:N) → Order (1:N) → LineItem · Payment · Shipment fan out from the Order aggregate root.
Read left-to-right. FK chains: Customer.customer_id is referenced by Address, Order. Order.order_id is referenced by LineItem, Payment, Shipment.
